system.description:
Even other Cainites are dazzled by your speed; you snatch falling objects from the air, and the wind of your passing whips clothes and loose debris about.

Invoking all of your Celerity at the cost of a single Blood Trait lets you use the Bomb in challenges of speed and agility — dodging an attack, throwing a knife, snatching something from another's grasp. The Bomb (a fist with the thumb pointing up) defeats Rock and Paper but loses to Scissors and ties other Bombs; it is optional, and remains available in any speed challenge throughout the turn. You may rely on Rapidity in any challenge where you use your own speed even if your opponent uses strength or stamina — against an opponent with Might you may still use the Bomb for speed, though he keeps his Might retest for grappling. Celerity draws no retest from any Ability.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
